name: Glaucous-Quoin

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past massive canyon systems, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.

The air carries dust and something faintly floral, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
